## Scope
Post-freeze, descriptive MOV0 interaction/archetype diagnostic only.

- SHA-verifies and reads the authoritative frozen MOV0 MIN/FULL OOF files.
- Uses fixed 33rd/67th predictor-only state thresholds from frozen corrected F02 (pooled 2015+ fighter states).
- Pre-registers 15 symmetric striking, grappling, mixed, and survival archetypes.
- Joins immutable Validation Terrain V1; reports bucket composition, terrain, weight class, Wilson intervals, calibration gaps, and MIN→FULL shifts.
- Preserves the successfully validated evidence as a permanent reference under `docs/model_diagnostics/`.

## Merge-safety controls

- The diagnostic workflow is read-only and no longer commits/pushes from Actions.
- Evidence is outside `models/mov0/`, so this PR does not trigger the frozen MOV0-run workflow.
- Contract coverage is outside `tests/models/`, so it does not trigger M0.
- No MOV0 fit, prediction regeneration, new model features, odds, ROI/EV, MOV1, or simulator code.

Validated final head: `88f7e820706fb5df8ccd89c0c2f86675b870a90e`
- MOV0 Conditional Feature Interaction Archetype Diagnostic V1: success
- F01 V1 Materializer: success

No automatic merge.

prs.body:
Freezes the first MOV1 experiment as P(KO/TKO | STANDARD_FINISH), with KO=1 and submission=0. This PR contains contract specifications and input validation only; no model was fitted, no MOV1 performance was evaluated, and no simulator was built.

Starting main: `4d641e259d4420fd77290603cabcce33c90bf6c8` (merged #117), verified unchanged before publication.

The contract fixes C0/C1/MIN/FULL; exact 5/35/55-column allowlists and a 55-row mechanism/rationale table; symmetric pooled-median transformations; finish-only chronological training/inner selection; all-eligible outer scoring; L2 logistic settings/grid; metrics, bootstrap/persistence reporting and fixed probability buckets. It fixes frozen MOV0-MIN composition and S0–S3 complete-system evaluation, immutable terrain/archetype diagnostics, interpretation boundaries, future output schemas and mandatory runtime checks.

Population: 5,658 modern eligible bouts (1,812 KO, 1,010 SUB, 2,836 DEC), including 2,822 conditional finishes. Outer 2018–2026 scoring: 4,260 bouts; conditional metrics: 2,115 finishes. Exact outer/inner class counts and ordered fight-ID hashes are committed. The 2015+ gate applies to fitting/preprocessing rows; existing governed F02 career history is consumed unchanged rather than recomputed.

Validation: all 55 literal predictors exist in the authoritative corrected F02 (physical SHA256 `d8a82dc7baf3d6e85c987e7fbfc63bb6329d59407cd8a66e5f228e0012e6b580`). Foundation/canonical labels, PIT-governed career families, nested allowlists, symmetric pair closure, canonical categorical mapping, fold counts/IDs, complete scoring coverage, finite training support and illustrative probability algebra pass locally. The added Actions workflow repeats these checks without installing or fitting an estimator.

The FULL KD efficiency addition declares the partial linear redundancy of marginal means with the existing directional gap; marginal intensity and side contrasts still add information not recoverable from MIN alone. Actual fitted-probability invariance, convergence and predictive calibration are mandatory checks for the later separately authorized run.

prs.body:
Executes merged #118 exactly, with no changes to F02, MOV0, terrain, archetypes, the structural audit or the MOV1 contract.

Starting main: `b6a644d9ef8d267f7d7da97f21e691f2bae99226`.
Implementation frozen before historical fitting: `31008e323d0ac579c8b93d810918c23ff15df5a1`.
Evidence head: `83822191168a94f4a0eef2b9f26295c0b9492b5b`.
Contract manifest SHA256: `9034e647bebaa7099f5358ed7a5db0e1bc515df1894db912274e5dae629cb714`.

## Result

| Conditional surface | Log loss | Brier | Three-way system | Multiclass log loss | Summed Brier |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|
| C0 | 0.651593 | 0.229507 | S0 | 0.993740 | 0.594575 |
| C1 | 0.641605 | 0.224829 | S1 | 0.988782 | 0.592501 |
| MIN | 0.615366 | 0.213614 | S2 | 0.975754 | 0.586206 |
| FULL | 0.619689 | 0.215100 | S3 | 0.977901 | 0.586869 |

Conditional MIN beyond C1: **CLEAR_SUCCESS** (9/9 favorable years; delta−0.026239; fight95 [−0.037958,−0.013835], event95 [−0.037655,−0.014047]).
Composed S2 beyond S1: **CLEAR_SUCCESS** (9/9 favorable; delta−0.013027; fight95 [−0.018826,−0.007284], event95 [−0.018882,−0.006961]).
FULL increment over MIN: **CURRENT_SPECIFICATION_NOT_SUPPORTED** (7/9 worse years; conditional/composed Brier worse; composed fight interval barely crosses zero, event interval slightly positive).

These are separate conclusions. Shared frozen F makes conditional and composed log-loss deltas algebraically related; classwise calibration and multiclass Brier add distinct checks.

## Limitations

MIN calibration slope0.831, ECE0.0314 and mean conditional KO66.3% versus actual64.3%. B3/B5 shift toward submission but remain about9 conditional percentage points too KO-heavy. Women's Strawweight is less well matched than C1. S2 submission ECE worsens versus S1 despite better aggregate log loss/Brier. Decision-node probabilities remain unchanged and overpredict prevalence by2.32 points. FULL was retained unchanged; no posthoc removal, tuning or recalibration.

## Verification and evidence

All exact inputs/allowlists/fold counts/ID hashes pass. Modern eligibility: 2,822 finishes (1,812 KO /1,010 SUB); outer scoring4,260, conditional evaluation2,115. All216 inner and27 outer fits converge, max56 iterations, zero solver warnings. Swap error0; representative MIN2021 refit identical float64 in the pinned environment; every persisted binary/composed probability regenerates with max error0. Composition sum error1.11e−16; no dropped rows or outcome-dependent scoring. Five synthetic guardrail tests pass.

86 run evidence files include36 fitted records, all surface/system predictions, preprocessing/solver/swap/selection records, conditional/composed metrics and calibration, annual paired uncertainty, all-division/archetype/terrain tables, fixed buckets, coefficients, pathway decomposition and simulator interpretation. [Independent full CI reproduction passed](https://github.com/Tkcool28/ufc-edge/actions/runs/36815096908): immutable input verification, five guardrail tests, saved-model regeneration, complete frozen rerun, and both full prediction-table comparisons within atol=1e-12, rtol=0. All 85 manifest-listed evidence files were also rechecked against their recorded SHA256 hashes.

- [Final report](models/mov1/run_v1/MOV1_KO_VS_SUBMISSION_GIVEN_FINISH_V1_REPORT.md)
- [Separate conclusions](models/mov1/run_v1/INTERPRETATION.md)
- [Pathway decomposition](models/mov1/run_v1/PATHWAY_DECOMPOSITION_REPORT.md)
- [Evidence manifest](models/mov1/run_v1/EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json)

Evidence-manifest SHA256: `cb21ff773489f23f4583a6487942e3edb05c817493aa04eff71a470f7b1086c6`.

No odds/ROI/EV, new features/folds/family, hierarchy, nonlinear models, simulator code or automatic merge.

prs.body:
Recovers the individual XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost finish-pathway evidence from PR #121 without training, rescoring, changing predictions or selecting a production winner. BOOST-SELECT remains INCONCLUSIVE.

**Dependency:** stacked on unmerged draft #121 at exact head `859be9fad8a1a95cf35f3e5bb99107205734ddce`. Main remains `4ec01227a4a35872eed51ce7ce67c45b02e46ebd`. This PR changes only audit reports, the read-only runner, independent verifier/test and zero-fit CI; no original model, feature, terrain or data artifacts change. Do not merge automatically.

The central report gives separate KO probability, conditional log loss and Brier matrices. All 15 frozen archetypes retain MATCH/NO_MATCH/UNASSIGNABLE, every division and immutable terrain, annual/configuration coverage, fixed buckets and independent finish sample gates. It also retains B3/B5 focused analyses, all qualifying primary-cell fight-level differences, 32 prediction-selected examples (including errors), paired fight/event intervals and family-composed systems.

Key findings:
- All shadows improve pooled conditional LL/Brier and ECE descriptively; all improve LL in 7/9 years, but all aggregate paired intervals span zero.
- All improve B3 individual LL/Brier while worsening its mean KO bias (MIN 55.2%, XGB 57.5%, LGBM 57.1%, CAT 57.2%; actual 46.0%).
- All move B5 toward submission and improve losses. CAT has the strongest observed B5 shift and lowest B3/B5 losses, without a confirmation/promotion claim.
- XGB has the strongest observed A1/A4 loss preservation. All improve Heavyweight; all worsen men's/women's Flyweight LL. A1 improves 5/9 years per family; A4 improves 7/9 XGB/LGBM and 3/9 CAT.
- Exact SELECT/shadow equality by selected year and inner/outer differences are documented. Better shadows do not prove selector instability.
- Existing importance/co-use cover SELECT folds only. No causal or shadow-wide interaction claim is made.

Validation: all three pinned manifest digests match; 189 source artifacts, 16 evaluation archive members and 3,987 native members verified. Same 4,260 scoring fights / 2,115 actual finishes for every surface. Independent verifier checks 660 cells, source/composed probabilities and reproduces all aggregate LL/Brier fight/event bootstrap intervals to 1e-12. Direct local regression test and staged whitespace check pass. No boosted libraries or predictive fit/train/predict calls are used. New CI runs the independent test with evaluation-only dependencies.

Evidence: `docs/model_diagnostics/mov1_three_family_finish_pathways_v1/` — start with `FINAL_AUDIT_REPORT.md` and `THREE_FAMILY_FINISH_PATHWAY_COMPARISON.md`. 49 audit artifacts plus their manifest; no native binaries duplicated.

Evidence manifest SHA256: `00b02e3442686689b1ffaca00816ea3e050837809c8a3a6cbf94d2bd9328f0d2`.

Final-head validation: workflow [36899481672](https://github.com/Tkcool28/ufc-edge/actions/runs/36899481672) passed the independent evidence regression test and whitespace check at `abdac4135aea1e74c4156429105711e1a41437bd`. Starting verified main: `6f92ce406af77758bacd2ce1f91fbbce0b4fc64b`. The branch extends the original partial #123; no frozen F02/MOV0/MOV1/archetype/terrain changes, no calibration/predictive fitting, no post-2026-08-15 outcome inspection or automatic merge.

Independent prior-only reconstruction of four relevant source measurements: 48/48 on six real fights, max absolute error 4.44e-16, global/strict-prior division population priors checked. Four actual zero-history fighter-side fixtures verify 16 nulls; same-date/target excluded. Original F01 sources unchanged.

**Actual preyear training completeness**: 2018 first fold 707 finishes (451 KO/256 SUB); 561 complete on four submission literal inputs (361 KO/200 SUB). All nine years and 224 division/year cells with per-class completeness committed. Under predefined outcome-blind approximate-marginal rule: 4,561 complete modern matchups, 680 multi-fight bins, 59 materially directionally contrasting bins (171 fights, 3.75%); this is not a claim that exact full-vector collisions occur historically or that an interaction improves predictive results. Existing B3/B5 saved-only chronological, division, experience and missingness diagnostic is verified; B5 355/355 complete yet retains mean KO bias. Sample gates honored, sparse fits suppressed, diagnostic calibration not applied.

**Source/evidence manifest SHA256**: `e04409314831753ab00a218bc07f04273c73f19d28507581099f4e1adc5f6488`. Dedicated workflow independently downloads/hashes physical F02, runs pytest collision, independent numeric source reconstruction, saved-only B3/B5 analysis, regenerates committed manifest exactly, uploads 90-day five-file evidence artifact, checks whitespace. See `docs/model_diagnostics/mov1_directional_representation_v1/MOV1_DIRECTIONAL_REPRESENTATION_AUDIT_V1.md`, `EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json`, and completion marker.

**Next task recommended only as separate implementation CONTRACT:** `MOV1_DIRECTIONAL_INTERACTION_CHALLENGER_V1`, fixed single fighter-swap invariant `sub_created_f1 × sub_faced_f2 + sub_created_f2 × sub_faced_f1` numeric interaction on existing frozen 35-literal MIN inputs with same imputation/chronology/L2 logistic, no new TD term or calibration. No model trained here. Previously observed outer years are not sealed confirmation; freeze forward eligibility after Aug 15 before later outcomes are inspected.

PR remains **DRAFT**. Do not merge automatically.
